differential.name: Acute ST‑segment elevation myocardial infarction
differential.rationale: Active diagnosis with classic risk factors (HTN, DM, dyslipidemia, obesity) and recent STEMI coding.

differential.name: Unstable angina / non‑ST‑segment elevation myocardial infarction
differential.rationale: Similar ischemic presentation in a high‑risk patient; may precede or follow STEMI.

differential.name: Pulmonary embolism
differential.rationale: Acute dyspnea/chest pain possible in immobilized, obese, hypercoagulable patient; must be excluded emergently.

differential.name: Acute aortic dissection
differential.rationale: Severe chest pain in older hypertensive individual; less likely without radiographic clues but critical to consider.

differential.name: Acute pericarditis
differential.rationale: Chest pain with possible ST changes; can mimic MI but less common in this risk profile.
